acceptanceCriteria: A dogfood event computes the repository context once and reuses it for the stability check where the contract allows, or the spec states why the second probe is required and bounds its cost.
A measured before/after on a dirty worktree of at least 2,000 paths shows the event's repository-probe time and deadline-fallback rate, with the frozen evaluation unchanged.
Drift between the start and end of the event is still detected and refused (no stale context presented as current).
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Found by the V1-0870 lane (2026-10-06): the dogfood-event-deadline fallback on the primary comes from ProbeRepositoryContext costing about 400 ms over roughly 2,500 dirty paths, run twice per event, at load average 17-45, against an effective adapter budget of about 1.5 s. Not caused by snapshot reuse or eviction. Related open investigation: V1-0607 (Codex user-prompt deadline fallback on the active mixed-worktree batch).

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#648 (rc3 batch 4), merged to main 2026-10-07T12:32:21Z as 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 (head 580fcde4, base 0c27e35f48581601fbfaf9613d0216b5f8ca3a46). Evidence (each digest is that file's sha256 at the merge commit): sealed CEM .corvint/changes/4497acbdc2443a7558337ed650bcea433fc9ae64.cem.json; docs/decisions/0439-rc3-batch-4-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md (owner acceptance of the batch 4 requirements); docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0881-single-event-bracket.md. Manual route because native completion is refused for a reason unrelated to evidence: on V1-0904, claim, submit (tree 6b9f2b71) and gate run focused-docs in a clean worktree at the merge commit all succeeded, but complete --commit 8c02f255 refused STALE_TREE with warning 'commit 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 is not reachable from main'. Local main in the primary checkout is cd70ba0a and holds 2,651 uncommitted paths that may not be touched, so it cannot be fast-forwarded; that attempt was released with reason STALE_TREE. NOT_RUN: make gate, -race, live fleet qualification where the spec says so; macOS CPU ticks not delivered (decision 0439 limits).

title: Dogfood events probe the repository twice; on a ~2,500-path dirty worktree under load that alone exceeds the adapter deadline
